meta.title: Request cost
meta.description: Adds request cost to the chat: a chip under every completed answer (per request) and, right below it, the whole-session total. Prices come from the DeepSeek pricing page in USD with the peak and off-peak tariffs, shown together with rubles and yuan at the current online rate; click for the input, cache and output tokens. The session total uses the log-wide token usage, so it does not change while older history pages load. It reads the session log already on disk and writes nothing to the session. One optional network request leaves the browser: the reference rates from open.er-api.com, cached for six hours, with no prices, prompts or tokens sent. Chinese public holidays are not accounted for, so those days price as peak. A model outside the table reads as price unknown, never as free. Figures are an estimate, not a bill. Disabling removes both chips.
